inputs.name: auditFunctionNames.file
inputs.description: The file's repository-relative path, extension, and structural source lines. The audit recognizes function declarations and const arrow-function declarations from line-start patterns, permits PascalCase in .jsx and .tsx files, and permits HTTP verbs only in +server.ts files.

examples.contents:
export function FormatDate(value) { return value; }
const formatDate = (value) => value;

inputs.name: hasNamedValueExport.lines
inputs.description: Source lines to inspect for a named runtime value export. The check recognizes exported function declarations, exported const declarations, and forwarded value exports; it ignores type-only exports.

inputs.name: hasNamedValueExport.name
inputs.description: The export name to search for in the supplied lines. It is matched as a declared function or const name, or as the final name of a forwarded value export.

outputs.name: auditFunctionNames
outputs.description: Findings for recognized function declarations and const arrow-function declarations whose names do not meet the allowed patterns. Each finding contains the file's relative path, the function-name-pattern rule id, and a message that names the offending function.

outputs.name: hasNamedValueExport
outputs.description: Whether the supplied lines declare or forward the requested named runtime value export. Type-only exports do not count.
